bagPolicy.summary: Only single-compartment clear plastic bags up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, infant and medical bags, and clutches or purses no larger than 5 by 7 inches are allowed. All other backpacks and bags are prohibited.

parking.note: Gallagher Square is the park-within-the-park at Petco Park in downtown San Diego, so use Petco Park parking: the Padres Parkade, Tailgate Park, and nearby East Village garages and lots. Prepaid parking is cheaper than drive-up, and the MTS Trolley stops a short walk away.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Gallagher Square at Petco Park's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Gallagher Square at Petco Park offers a variety of food and beverage options, including classic comfort foods with bold flavors and modern twists. Highlights include specialty items like Bacon Wrapped Hot Dogs, Pastrami Fries, and indulgent treats such as Soft Serve and Milkshakes. The venue features a lively Beer Garden and several concession stands serving high-quality, satisfying bites.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Electrical outlets for recharging wheelchairs are located in all seating areas designated for guests with a wheelchair accessible ticket.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: For Padres games and events at Petco Park, re-entry is permitted: have your digital ticket scanned before you exit, then scan back in. Re-entry is not allowed once the game or event has ended. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Petco Park Main Box Office is on Park Blvd. On non-game days it is open Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM; on Padres game days it opens at 10 AM and stays open until 90 minutes after first pitch. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Gallagher Square at Petco Park. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
